dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of small, solid light-pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge and posterior segment.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the central dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with smaller clusters forming a linear arrangement toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinct, saturated red-orange elliptical reflection is present in the anterior ocular region.
